text:
ryan: quick flag from the onboarding sweep: qwen-13b int4 artifact shows odd rerank swaps and brittle long-context retrieval. overall token-level loss ok but embeddings permute top-k.

emma: can you paste the mini metrics?

ryan: smoke run (2k queries):
- qwen-fp16 baseline mean cosine = 0.83
- qwen-int4-conv mean cosine = 0.54
- rerank nDCG@10 drop = 0.14 absolute
- failing example: query 'tax credits for solar' top1 -> article about unrelated artist interview

pavel: big cosine delta. pattern? sign flips or phase misalignment in rotary could warp nearest-neighbors. did you check per-dim sign agreement vs baseline?

ryan: ran a seeded probe (5k tokens). snippet:
```
# probe pseudocode
E_fp = embed_qwen_fp16(tokens)
E_int4 = embed_qwen_int4(tokens)
sign_agree = np.mean(np.sign(E_fp) == np.sign(E_int4), axis=0)
print(sign_agree[:10])
# -> [0.98, 0.03, 0.97, 0.04, 0.96, 0.02, 0.95, 0.05, 0.97, 0.01]
```
looks like alternating dims are inverted.

emma: alternating pattern suggests headwise or even-odd rotary phase flip combined with signed-SVD collapse during fold. also I recall a vocab remap step we added for qwen that shifts token ids by +1 for sentinel layout; if that got applied twice you could be indexing wrong embedding rows while also folding projections incorrectly.

varun: converters sometimes do two things in fold: 1) SVD-based projection fold with a diag sign-normalize, 2) reindex embeddings for remapped vocab and then pack heads interleaved for cache. if the remap permutes rows but the sign diag was absorbed assuming original indexing, you get mixed orientation per-dim.

ryan: I profiled embedding centroids per-token-id. surprising find: centroid for token id 1023 in int4 maps to centroid of id 1024 in fp16, and a per-dim sign inversion on the even dims. dump excerpt:
```
token 1023 fp centroid[:8] = [0.12, -0.03, 0.07, -0.02, 0.09, -0.01, 0.11, -0.04]
int4 mapped centroid[:8]  = [-0.12, -0.03, -0.07, -0.02, -0.09, -0.01, -0.11, -0.04]
```
so row mapping + sign flip on certain dims.

pavel: reproducible hack: remap int4 embed rows back by -1 and flip even dims sign, then quick rerank -> mean cosine 0.82, nDCG restored to within 0.02.

emma: that confirms two orthogonal bugs: a) double-application of the vocab remap during export, b) signed-SVD normalization that lost orthant metadata when absorbing into folded weights. both combine to produce the observed alternating-dim flips.

varun: pragmatic plan: 1) add a tiny CI regression that runs embed parity on a seeded token list (fixed 2048 tokens) and asserts mean cosine >= 0.8 of baseline; 2) update qwen exporter to emit vocab_map metadata in artifact and assert remapping idempotence during packing; 3) change fold_svd to persist sign_diag vector and apply it consistently when folding into per-head blocks; 4) add an integration smoke which runs the 2k query rerank on CI for converter PRs.

ci-bot: created issue #7812: "qwen exporter vocab double-remap + signed-SVD orthant loss" and uploaded artifact qwen-int4-broken.onnx sha=8f3a9c.

ryan: I'll open a minimal repro gist showing the centroid mismatch and a tiny script that flips the even dims as a temporary test. but we need the proper fix in exporter not hacks.

pavel: for the fold change, prefer preserving the sign_diag as a separate small vector w_sign per head and serialize into metadata (json sidecar). quantizer should honor w_sign when computing per-channel scales to avoid implicit sign inference from symmetric clamping.

varun: also grep gemma/mistral exporters for similar vocab_remap flags. I suspect remap was added to support a sentinel token shift and might have been recently enabled by default for qwen only.

emma: I'll add an agenda item to onboard sync to propose mandatory embed-parity CI test for all new model exporters. this would've caught the double-remap earlier.

ryan: marking qwen int4 rollout blocked until converter PR fixes land and CI rerun passes. will post PR link and the repro gist shortly.

pavel: nice triage. also add the probe commands and a compact runbook entry: symptoms (alternating-dim sign flips + token centroid offset), checks (sign_agree vector, centroid diff, pack_map), fixes (preserve sign_diag, emit vocab_map metadata, CI embed parity).

ci-bot: PR pipeline queued for converter fix (#2046)  tests pending.

varun: thumbs up. once PR merges run the full 50k rerank sweep; if any head-specific flips persist we may need headwise sign vectors rather than per-dim.

ryan: thanks team, posting repro and small artifact after PR.
